nodes.name: RuleStatus.java
nodes.summary: Enumeration of API rate-limit rule lifecycle statuses (code/message pairs) with static lookup helpers resolving messages and enum entries by code.

nodes.name: RuleStatus
nodes.summary: Enum defining rule statuses with code and msg fields plus getMsg/getRc static resolvers used across customize services.

nodes.name: AllRuleDto.java
nodes.summary: Composite request DTO bundling a base rate-limit RuleDto with its list of depth (time-window) rule DTOs.

nodes.name: AllRuleDto
nodes.summary: Aggregates the normal rule and depth rule list into a single add-rules payload.

nodes.name: DepthRuleDto.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for creating a depth (time-window-scoped) API restriction rule with start/end windows, stat time, threshold, and effective time.

nodes.name: DepthRuleDto
nodes.summary: Carries all fields needed to define a time-window depth rule including status and limit API target.

nodes.name: DepthRuleStatusDto.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for toggling the status of an existing depth rule by id.

nodes.name: DepthRuleStatusDto
nodes.summary: Holds depth rule id and target status for status-update requests.

nodes.name: DepthRuleUpdateDto.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for updating an existing depth rule, mirroring DepthRuleDto fields plus the rule id.

nodes.name: DepthRuleUpdateDto
nodes.summary: Update payload for depth rules carrying id and all modifiable rule fields.

nodes.name: RuleDto.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for creating a normal API restriction rule with stat time, threshold, effective time, and limit API target.

nodes.name: RuleDto
nodes.summary: Carries fields needed to define a normal rate-limit rule.

nodes.name: RuleGetDto.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for fetching a single rule by id.

nodes.name: RuleGetDto
nodes.summary: Single-field DTO wrapping the rule id for get-by-id requests.

nodes.name: RuleStatusDto.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for toggling the status of an existing normal rule by id.

nodes.name: RuleStatusDto
nodes.summary: Holds rule id and target status for status-update requests.

nodes.name: RuleUpdateDto.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for updating an existing normal rule, mirroring RuleDto fields plus the rule id.

nodes.name: RuleUpdateDto
nodes.summary: Update payload for normal rules carrying id and all modifiable rule fields.

nodes.name: AllDepthRuleVo.java
nodes.summary: Composite view object returning the active normal rule together with its list of depth rules.

nodes.name: AllDepthRuleVo
nodes.summary: Aggregates a RuleVo and its DepthRuleVo list for combined rule retrieval.

nodes.name: DepthRuleVo.java
nodes.summary: View object exposing a depth rule's time windows, stat/effective time, threshold, limit API, status, and creation time to clients.

nodes.name: DepthRuleVo
nodes.summary: Full read model of a depth rule returned by the customize service.

nodes.name: RuleVo.java
nodes.summary: View object exposing a normal rule's stat/effective time, threshold, limit API, status, and creation time to clients.

nodes.name: RuleVo
nodes.summary: Full read model of a normal rate-limit rule returned by the customize service.

nodes.name: AllRuleController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing endpoints to add the combined normal-plus-depth rule set and to fetch the full active rule aggregate.

nodes.name: AllRuleController
nodes.summary: Spring MVC controller delegating combined rule add/get operations to AllRuleService.

nodes.name: DepthRuleController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller for depth rule management: add, update, update status, and list all depth rules.

nodes.name: DepthRuleController
nodes.summary: Spring MVC controller delegating depth rule CRUD operations to DepthRuleService.

nodes.name: RuleController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller for normal rule management: add, update, update status, and get by id.

nodes.name: RuleController
nodes.summary: Spring MVC controller delegating normal rule CRUD operations to RuleService.

nodes.name: DepthRule.java
nodes.summary: MyBatis-Plus entity mapped to the depth rule table holding time-window restriction rule fields.

nodes.name: DepthRule
nodes.summary: Lombok @Data entity extending BaseTableData with depth rule columns such as time windows, threshold, and limit API.

nodes.name: Rule.java
nodes.summary: MyBatis-Plus entity mapped to the d_rule table holding normal API restriction rule fields.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.summary: Lombok @Data entity extending BaseTableData with normal rule columns such as stat time, threshold, and limit API.

nodes.name: DepthRuleMapper.java
nodes.summary: MyBatis-Plus mapper interface for DepthRule adding a delAll operation to clear all depth rules.

nodes.name: DepthRuleMapper
nodes.summary: BaseMapper extension providing bulk delete of all depth rules.

nodes.name: RuleMapper.java
nodes.summary: MyBatis-Plus mapper interface for Rule adding a delAll operation to clear all normal rules.

nodes.name: RuleMapper
nodes.summary: BaseMapper extension providing bulk delete of all normal rules.

nodes.name: AllRuleService.java
nodes.summary: Service orchestrating combined rule management: validates depth rule time windows against each other, delegates persistence to RuleService/DepthRuleService, and assembles the aggregate rule view.

nodes.name: AllRuleService
nodes.summary: Spring service coordinating normal and depth rule writes with time-window overlap validation and aggregate retrieval.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Adds the normal rule, clears and re-adds depth rules after time-window validation, then refreshes the rule cache.

nodes.name: checkTime
nodes.summary: Validates that a new depth rule's start/end time window does not overlap windows of existing running depth rules, throwing DaMaiFrameException on conflict.

nodes.name: DepthRuleService.java
nodes.summary: Service for depth rule persistence and lifecycle: add with UID generation, update, status toggle, list as VOs, and bulk delete, refreshing the Redis rule cache after mutations.

nodes.name: DepthRuleService
nodes.summary: Spring service managing depth rule CRUD with time-window overlap checks and cache refresh via RuleService.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Checks a candidate time window against all running depth rules stored in the database, rejecting overlaps with a DaMaiFrameException.

nodes.name: RuleService.java
nodes.summary: Service for normal rule persistence and cache management: add/update/status/get operations plus saveAllRuleCache which loads running normal and depth rules into a Redis hash for gateway-side API restriction.

nodes.name: RuleService
nodes.summary: Spring service managing normal rule CRUD and synchronizing active rules into Redis for the gateway's API restriction checks.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Deletes existing rules, then inserts a new normal rule with a Baidu UID id and creation timestamp.

nodes.name: saveAllRuleCache
nodes.summary: Loads the running normal rule and all running depth rules, then rewrites them as entries of a Redis hash keyed by RedisKeyManage so the gateway can enforce API restrictions.

nodes.name: DepthRuleVo.java
nodes.summary: Gateway-side view object of a depth rule enriched with resolved start/end time-window timestamps for runtime API restriction checks.

nodes.name: DepthRuleVo
nodes.summary: Depth rule read model used by the gateway's ApiRestrictService, including computed window timestamps.

nodes.name: RuleVo.java
nodes.summary: Gateway-side view object of a normal rule used when enforcing API restriction limits at the gateway.

nodes.name: RuleVo
nodes.summary: Normal rule read model consumed by the gateway's ApiRestrictService.
